meteormash.desc: Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.desc: A random move is selected for use, other than Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, or any move the user already knows.

milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
milkdrink.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
milkdrink.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.shortDesc: The last move the target used replaces this one.
mimic.desc: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has 5 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle.

mindreader.name: Mind Reader
mindreader.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.
mindreader.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. When this effect is started against the target, this and Lock-On's effects end for every other Pokemon against that target. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement remains under this effect. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, this effect is restarted against the same target for the replacement. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Stomp will have its power doubled if used against the user while it is active.

miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleeye.desc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Psychic-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Dark type.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.shortDesc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.
mirrorcoat.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn, or if the user did not lose HP from the attack.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.shortDesc: User uses the target's last used move against it.
mirrormove.desc: The user uses the last move that successfully targeted the user. The copied move is used with no specific target. Fails if no move has targeted the user, if the move was called by another move, if the move is Encore, or if the move cannot be copied by this move.

mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorshot.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mirrorshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

mist.name: Mist
mist.shortDesc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from stat drops.
mist.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

mistball.name: Mist Ball
mistball.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
mistball.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
moonlight.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.

morningsun.name: Morning Sun
morningsun.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
morningsun.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.

mudbomb.name: Mud Bomb
mudbomb.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mudbomb.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

muddywater.name: Muddy Water
muddywater.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the foe(s) accuracy by 1.
muddywater.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

mudshot.name: Mud Shot
mudshot.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
mudshot.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

mudslap.name: Mud-Slap
mudslap.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mudslap.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

mudsport.name: Mud Sport
mudsport.shortDesc: Weakens Electric-type attacks to 1/2 their power.
mudsport.desc: While the user is active, all Electric-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power halved. Fails if this effect is already active for the user. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

nastyplot.name: Nasty Plot
nastyplot.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
nastyplot.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

naturalgift.name: Natural Gift
naturalgift.shortDesc: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.
naturalgift.desc: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo is in effect for the user.

naturepower.name: Nature Power
naturepower.shortDesc: Attack changes based on terrain. (Tri Attack)
naturepower.desc: This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack in Wi-Fi battles.

needlearm.name: Needle Arm
needlearm.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
needlearm.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.shortDesc: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.
nightmare.desc: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.

nightshade.name: Night Shade
nightshade.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
nightshade.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

nightslash.name: Night Slash
nightslash.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
octazooka.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorsleuth.shortDesc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
odorsleuth.desc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type.

ominouswind.name: Ominous Wind
ominouswind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
ominouswind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
outrage.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused at the end of the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
overheat.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

painsplit.name: Pain Split
painsplit.shortDesc: Shares HP of user and target equally.
painsplit.desc: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.

payback.name: Payback
payback.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user moves after the target.
payback.desc: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn. Switching in counts as an action.

perishsong.name: Perish Song
perishsong.shortDesc: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.
perishsong.desc: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
petaldance.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused at the end of the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile
pinmissile.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 3/8 chance to hit two or three times, and a 1/8 chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the target has a Focus Sash and had full HP when this move started, it will not be knocked out regardless of the number of hits.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.shortDesc: User steals and eats the target's Berry.
pluck.desc: The user steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects unless the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move can be regained with Recycle.

poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
poisonfang.shortDesc: 30% chance to badly poison the target.
poisonfang.desc: Has a 30% chance to badly poison the target.

poisonjab.name: Poison Jab
poisonjab.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

poisonsting.name: Poison Sting
poisonsting.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

poisontail.name: Poison Tail
poisontail.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.
poisontail.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

powdersnow.name: Powder Snow
powdersnow.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

powerswap.name: Power Swap
powerswap.shortDesc: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.
powerswap.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.

powertrick.name: Power Trick
powertrick.shortDesc: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.
powertrick.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

present.name: Present
present.shortDesc: 40, 80, 120 power, or heals target 1/4 max HP.
present.desc: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

protect.name: Protect
protect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.
protect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and doubles each time this move is successfully used, up to a maximum of 8. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Detect, Endure, or Protect. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
psychic.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

psychoboost.name: Psycho Boost
psychoboost.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
psychoboost.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

psychocut.name: Psycho Cut
psychocut.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

psychoshift.name: Psycho Shift
psychoshift.shortDesc: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.
psychoshift.desc: The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.

psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.shortDesc: Copies the target's current stat stages.
psychup.desc: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.shortDesc: Random damage equal to 0.5x-1.5x user's level.
psywave.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) * (X * 10 + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 10, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.shortDesc: 60 power +20 for each of the target's stat boosts.
punishment.desc: Power is equal to 60+(X*20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.shortDesc: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2x power.
pursuit.desc: If an opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using U-turn, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon becomes active immediately.

rage.name: Rage
rage.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.
rage.desc: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.

raindance.name: Rain Dance
raindance.shortDesc: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.
raindance.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain Dance. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain Dance.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.shortDesc: Frees user from hazards, binding, Leech Seed.
rapidspin.desc: If this move is successful, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end against the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field.

razorleaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorleaf.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.
razorleaf.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.shortDesc: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.
razorwind.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second.

recover.name: Recover
recover.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
recover.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.shortDesc: Restores the item the user last used.
recycle.desc: The user regains the item last used by a Pokemon in its current position on the field, even if that Pokemon was not the user. Fails if the user is holding an item, if no items have been used at the user's position, or if the item was lost to Covet, Knock Off, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.shortDesc: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.
reflect.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 1/2 damage from physical attacks, or 2/3 damage if there are multiple active Pokemon on the user's side. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.shortDesc: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.
refresh.desc: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

rest.name: Rest
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

return.name: Return
return.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.shortDesc: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.
revenge.desc: Power doubles if the user was hit by a Pokemon in the target's current position this turn.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.shortDesc: More power the less HP the user has left.
reversal.desc: The power of this move is 20 if X is 43 to 48, 40 if X is 22 to 42, 80 if X is 13 to 21, 100 if X is 6 to 12, 150 if X is 2 to 5, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 64 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

roar.name: Roar
roar.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
roar.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability, or if the user's level is lower than the target's and X * (user's level + target's level) / 256 + 1 is less than or equal to (target's level / 4), rounded down, where X is a random number from 0 to 255.

roaroftime.name: Roar of Time
roaroftime.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

rockblast.name: Rock Blast
rockblast.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 3/8 chance to hit two or three times, and a 1/8 chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the target has a Focus Sash and had full HP when this move started, it will not be knocked out regardless of the number of hits.

rockclimb.name: Rock Climb
rockclimb.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
rockslide.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rocksmash.name: Rock Smash
rocksmash.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
rocksmash.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

rocktomb.name: Rock Tomb
rocktomb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
rocktomb.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

rockwrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockwrecker.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.shortDesc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.
roleplay.desc: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is Multitype or already matches the target, if the target's Ability is Multitype or Wonder Guard, or if the user is holding a Griseous Orb.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
rollout.desc: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.

roost.name: Roost
roost.shortDesc: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.
roost.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Until the end of the turn, Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become typeless. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.

sacredfire.name: Sacred Fire
sacredfire.shortDesc: 50% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
sacredfire.desc: Has a 50% chance to burn the target.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.shortDesc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from status.
safeguard.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

sandattack.name: Sand Attack
sandattack.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.shortDesc: For 5 turns, a sandstorm rages. Rock: 1.5x SpD.
sandstorm.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.

sandtomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandtomb.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 2-5 turns.
sandtomb.desc: Prevents the target from switching for two to five turns (always five turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass or U-turn. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

scaryface.name: Scary Face
scaryface.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.

secretpower.name: Secret Power
secretpower.shortDesc: Effect varies with terrain. (30% paralysis chance)
secretpower.desc: Has a 30% chance to cause a secondary effect on the target based on the battle terrain. Causes paralysis on the regular Wi-Fi terrain.

seedflare.name: Seed Flare
seedflare.shortDesc: 40% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
seedflare.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

seismictoss.name: Seismic Toss
seismictoss.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
seismictoss.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

selfdestruct.name: Self-Destruct
selfdestruct.shortDesc: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.
selfdestruct.desc: The user faints after using this move, unless this move has no target. The target's Defense is halved during damage calculation. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

shadowball.name: Shadow Ball
shadowball.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
shadowball.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

shadowclaw.name: Shadow Claw
shadowclaw.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

shadowforce.name: Shadow Force
shadowforce.shortDesc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.
shadowforce.desc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Detect or Protect for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target is an opponent and its side is protected by Quick Guard or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the opponent's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

shadowpunch.name: Shadow Punch
shadowpunch.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

sheercold.name: Sheer Cold
sheercold.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
sheercold.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

shockwave.name: Shock Wave
shockwave.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

signalbeam.name: Signal Beam
signalbeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

silverwind.name: Silver Wind
silverwind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
silverwind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

sing.name: Sing
sing.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.shortDesc: Permanently copies the last move target used.
sketch.desc: This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Chatter, Sketch, Struggle, or any move the user knows.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.shortDesc: The user and the target trade Abilities.
skillswap.desc: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is Multitype or Wonder Guard, if both have the same Ability, or if either is holding a Griseous Orb.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.
skullbash.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.shortDesc: Charges, then hits turn 2. 30% flinch. High crit.
skyattack.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

skyuppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyuppercut.shortDesc: Can hit Pokemon using Bounce or Fly.
skyuppercut.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce or Fly.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

slash.name: Slash
slash.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.shortDesc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.
sleeptalk.desc: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Bide, Chatter, Copycat, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Sleep Talk, Uproar, or any two-turn move.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

sludgebomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludgebomb.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is paralyzed, and cures it.
smellingsalts.desc: Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If this move is successful, the target is cured of paralysis.

smog.name: Smog
smog.desc: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.shortDesc: User steals certain support moves to use itself.
snatch.desc: If another Pokemon uses certain non-damaging moves this turn, the user steals that move to use itself. If multiple Pokemon use this move this turn, the applicable moves are stolen by each of those Pokemon in turn order, and only the last user in turn order will gain the effects.

snore.name: Snore
snore.shortDesc: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.
snore.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
softboiled.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Damage is halved if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

spacialrend.name: Spacial Rend
spacialrend.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.
spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass or U-turn. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field, unless it uses Baton Pass, in which case the target will remain trapped.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 3/8 chance to hit two or three times, and a 1/8 chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the target has a Focus Sash and had full HP when this move started, it will not be knocked out regardless of the number of hits.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin successfully, or is hit by Defog.

spite.name: Spite
spite.shortDesc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.
spite.desc: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

spitup.name: Spit Up
spitup.shortDesc: More power with more uses of Stockpile.
spitup.desc: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. This move does not apply damage variance. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Unless there is no target, whether or not this move is successful the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

spore.name: Spore
spore.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.shortDesc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.
stealthrock.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin successfully, or is hit by Defog.

steelwing.name: Steel Wing
steelwing.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.
steelwing.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense, Sp. Def by 1. Max 3 uses.
stockpile.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
stomp.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target has used Minimize while active.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, or if the user switches out or faints. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.
suckerpunch.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.shortDesc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.
sunnyday.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
superfang.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.
superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

surf.name: Surf
surf.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Power doubles on Dive.
surf.desc: Power doubles if the target is using Dive.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.shortDesc: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.
swallow.desc: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

sweetkiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweetkiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage.

swift.name: Swift
swift.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.
swift.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.
switcheroo.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Griseous Orb, if neither is holding an item, if either has the Multitype Ability, if either is under the effect of Knock Off, or if the target has the Sticky Hold Ability.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded down.

tailglow.name: Tail Glow
tailglow.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
tailglow.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.shortDesc: For 3 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.
tailwind.desc: For 3 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.shortDesc: For 3-5 turns, the target can't use status moves.
taunt.desc: For 3 to 5 turns, prevents the target from using non-damaging moves.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

thief.name: Thief
thief.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.
thief.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Griseous Orb, or if the target has the Multitype Ability. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
thrash.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused at the end of the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce or Fly. If the weather is Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderfang.shortDesc: 10% chance to paralyze. 10% chance to flinch.
thunderfang.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thundershock.name: Thunder Shock
thundershock.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

torment.name: Torment
torment.shortDesc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.
torment.desc: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.shortDesc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.
toxicspikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, as well as switching in with a substitute.

transform.name: Transform
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, IVs, species, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP. This move fails if the target has transformed.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

trick.name: Trick
trick.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.
trick.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Griseous Orb, if neither is holding an item, if either has the Multitype Ability, if either is under the effect of Knock Off, or if the target has the Sticky Hold Ability.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.shortDesc: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.
trickroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon with lower Speed will move before those with higher Speed, within their priority brackets. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.
triplekick.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the target has a Focus Sash and had full HP when this move started, it will not be knocked out regardless of the number of hits.

trumpcard.name: Trump Card
trumpcard.shortDesc: More power the fewer PP this move has left.
trumpcard.desc: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.shortDesc: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.
twineedle.desc: Hits twice, with each hit having a 20% chance to poison the target. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. If the target has a Focus Sash and had full HP when this move started, it will not be knocked out regardless of the number of hits.

twister.name: Twister
twister.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
twister.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce or Fly.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.shortDesc: Lasts 3-6 turns. Active Pokemon cannot sleep.
uproar.desc: The user spends three to six turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. During effect, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon that are already asleep wake up as their turn starts or at the end of each turn, including the last one. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.
uturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

vitalthrow.name: Vital Throw
vitalthrow.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.
vitalthrow.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.shortDesc: Has 1/3 recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 the HP lost by the target, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

wakeupslap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wakeupslap.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.
wakeupslap.desc: Power doubles if the target is asleep. If this move is successful, the target wakes up.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

watersport.name: Water Sport
watersport.shortDesc: Weakens Fire-type attacks to 1/2 their power.
watersport.desc: While the user is active, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power halved. Fails if this effect is already active for the user. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
waterspout.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.shortDesc: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.
weatherball.desc: Power doubles if a weather condition is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Hail, Water type during Rain Dance, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Sunny Day.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 2-5 turns.
whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from switching for two to five turns (always five turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass or U-turn. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability, or if the user's level is lower than the target's and X * (user's level + target's level) / 256 + 1 is less than or equal to (target's level / 4), rounded down, where X is a random number from 0 to 255.

wish.name: Wish
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, heals 50% of the recipient's max HP.
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of its maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 the HP lost by the target, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is Multitype or Truant, or if the target is holding a Griseous Orb.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 2-5 turns.
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for two to five turns (always five turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass or U-turn. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
wringout.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP) + 1, rounded down.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Grass-type attacks have 1.5x power.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Fire-type attacks have 1.5x power.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Water-type attacks have 1.5x power.

shielddust.name: Shield Dust
shielddust.shortDesc: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack.

shedskin.name: Shed Skin
shedskin.shortDesc: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.

compoundeyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundeyes.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Bug-type attacks have 1.5x power.

keeneye.name: Keen Eye
keeneye.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage.

tangledfeet.name: Tangled Feet
tangledfeet.shortDesc: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

guts.name: Guts
guts.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5x; ignores burn halving physical damage.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

static.name: Static
static.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

sandveil.name: Sand Veil
sandveil.shortDesc: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25x; immunity to Sandstorm.

poisonpoint.name: Poison Point
poisonpoint.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks do 1.25x on same gender targets; 0.75x on opposite gender.

cutecharm.name: Cute Charm
cutecharm.shortDesc: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.

magicguard.name: Magic Guard
magicguard.shortDesc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks, and can't be fully paralyzed.

flashfire.name: Flash Fire
flashfire.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5x damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.

innerfocus.name: Inner Focus
innerfocus.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.shortDesc: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

effectspore.name: Effect Spore
effectspore.shortDesc: 30% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.

dryskin.name: Dry Skin
dryskin.shortDesc: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25x by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.

tintedlens.name: Tinted Lens
tintedlens.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.

arenatrap.name: Arena Trap
arenatrap.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.

technician.name: Technician
technician.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5x power, except Struggle.

limber.name: Limber
limber.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

damp.name: Damp
damp.shortDesc: Prevents Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while this Pokemon is active.

cloudnine.name: Cloud Nine
cloudnine.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

vitalspirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalspirit.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

angerpoint.name: Anger Point
angerpoint.shortDesc: If this Pokemon or its substitute takes a critical hit, its Attack is raised 12 stages.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.shortDesc: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.shortDesc: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.

noguard.name: No Guard
noguard.shortDesc: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

clearbody.name: Clear Body
clearbody.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

liquidooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidooze.shortDesc: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

rockhead.name: Rock Head
rockhead.shortDesc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortDesc: OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated. Gaining this Ability while infatuated cures it.

magnetpull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetpull.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.

earlybird.name: Early Bird
earlybird.shortDesc: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

thickfat.name: Thick Fat
thickfat.shortDesc: The power of Fire- and Ice-type attacks against this Pokemon is halved.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.shortDesc: This Pokemon has its status cured at the end of each turn if Rain Dance is active.

stickyhold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyhold.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.

shellarmor.name: Shell Armor
shellarmor.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

skilllink.name: Skill Link
skilllink.shortDesc: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Iron Ball nullify it.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the foes' move with the highest power.

hypercutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hypercutter.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, including Heal Bell.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningrod.shortDesc: This Pokemon draws single-target Electric moves to itself.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have 1.2x power; not Struggle.

ironfist.name: Iron Fist
ironfist.shortDesc: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2x power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.
